scene: The lever opens wall gates onto three waiting transit lines outside.
picture: Along a wide stone transit balcony, the dark-haired boy in a green striped shirt holds his skateboard left of centre. On the far left waits a yellow skate-park shuttle. To his right, an open red double-decker bus idles. On the far right, a wooden rope-bridge lift basket hangs from cables.
shown: a yellow ramped skate-park shuttle idling at the platform on the far left
a bright red double-decker bus with doors open on the right
a suspended wooden rope-bridge lift basket swinging on the far right
